title: Zesty Pungent Jalisco Style Mexican Shrimp Burrito
description: A sharp and refreshing burrito featuring shrimp marinated in a pungent mortar-pounded mustard and lime paste, inspired by the coastal rains of Jalisco.
instructions: Place the garlic, serrano peppers, and sea salt into a mortar and pestle.
Pound the mixture into a coarse, wet paste to release the pungent oils.
Whisk in the English mustard powder and lime juice until the paste is smooth.
Toss the raw shrimp with the mustard paste and let marinate for ten minutes.
Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Flash cook the shrimp for three minutes until they are just opaque and firm.
Remove the skillet from heat and stir in the raw diced onions and cilantro.
Lay the warmed flour tortillas on a flat work surface.
Divide the shrimp mixture evenly among the four tortillas.
Roll the tortillas tightly into burritos and serve immediately while zesty and hot.
